tools.name: gw_attach_evidence
tools.description: Link existing evidence to a finding in the same authorized report; no cross-report moves.

tools.name: gw_attach_library_finding
tools.description: Copy a reusable library finding into the authorized report using attachFinding.

tools.name: gw_create_finding
tools.description:
Create a finding directly in the external Ghostwriter report.

    Writes immediately with your Ghostwriter identity. Supply plain-text content
    drafted by the calling agent, and a finding_type_id from gw_get_finding_options
    unless a default is configured. Do not invent evidence, exploitation or CVSS.
    Optional sections may be left empty for further drafting. Saved complete=false
    for Ghostwriter QA. Reuses identical content when found. No local services or
    separate approval workflow are involved.

tools.name: gw_create_report
tools.description: Create a report in an existing allowed project. Cannot create projects or nested records.

tools.name: gw_delete_evidence
tools.description: Delete one scoped evidence record. Prefer deleteEvidence, use a schema-verified mutation fallback when absent, and report storage-cleanup uncertainty.

tools.name: gw_delete_finding
tools.description: Delete one finding from the specified report; cannot delete reports or projects.

tools.name: gw_download_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve evidence bytes as base64 through downloadEvidence; does not fetch URLs or save files.

tools.name: gw_generate_report
tools.description:
Request report-data JSON export and return base64 plus UI document URLs.

    The verified generateReport Action is read-only export despite GraphQL mutation
    syntax. Office rendering/download is unsupported and returns an explicit error.
    No URLs are fetched and no local export state is stored.

tools.name: gw_get_export
tools.description:
Retrieve and decode current report-data JSON through generateReport.

    Stateless read: this retrieves a fresh snapshot, not a saved export artifact.
    It never renders Office documents, fetches URLs or writes files.

tools.name: gw_get_finding_options
tools.description: List actual severity and finding-type IDs to select before creating a finding.

tools.name: gw_get_project
tools.description: Retrieve an authorized Ghostwriter project.

tools.name: gw_get_report
tools.description: Retrieve report metadata, extra-field values/specifications and selected template IDs.

tools.name: gw_list_evidence
tools.description: List report evidence metadata in bounded pages; file bytes are not downloaded.

tools.name: gw_list_findings
tools.description: Read all findings from an authorized report, paging the external API.

tools.name: gw_list_projects
tools.description: List projects visible to your token within configured client/project scopes.

tools.name: gw_list_reports
tools.description: List reports belonging to an authorized project.

tools.name: gw_list_templates
tools.description: List global/client templates available to the authorized project, including document types.

tools.name: gw_search_finding_library
tools.description: Search reusable Ghostwriter findings by title; requires upstream library read access.

tools.name: gw_select_report_templates
tools.description:
Select existing DOCX/PPTX templates, or explicitly null selections to clear them.

    Checks project/client visibility and document type; cannot upload or delete
    templates. Unspecified selections are preserved. Report QA status resets.

tools.name: gw_update_executive_summary
tools.description:
Save plain-text summary to an existing or registered report field; GW_SUMMARY_FIELD pins the field when configured.

    No universal summary field is assumed. Other extra fields are preserved through
    an atomic JSON patch. The report is marked incomplete for Ghostwriter QA.

tools.name: gw_update_finding
tools.description:
Edit a report finding directly using its Ghostwriter ID.

    Only supplied fields change; plain text is safely rendered. Ownership checks and
    an atomic comparison prevent cross-report writes and lost concurrent edits.
    Editing resets complete=false for QA. Never invent evidence or CVSS values.
    No local state or separate approval workflow is required.

tools.name: gw_update_report
tools.description: Change only title/complete/delivered/archived metadata. Cannot move reports or change templates/summary.

tools.name: gw_upload_evidence
tools.description:
Upload supplied base64 bytes to Ghostwriter. Accepts no local paths/URLs.

    File bytes remain unchanged; the upstream form decides supported file types.
    GW_MAX_FILE_BYTES limits size. Upload requires a supported uploadEvidence Action
    and token permissions. Use gw_attach_evidence separately to link a finding.
